## European Cups

### Bamberg Baskets Offer Discounts on Tickets and Merchandise

The Bamberg Baskets are hosting a 'Freaky Friday' promotion during their Freak Week, offering discounts on merchandise and tickets. Fans can purchase jerseys for €54.95, shorts for €24.95, or a bundle of both for €64.95. Additionally, a free flag is included with each purchase. The team is also offering 20% off all day tickets for upcoming home games against Hagen, Peristeri, Würzburg, Rostock, Frankfurt, and Chemnitz. For home games against Jena and Grünberg, tickets are available for €5. To receive the discounts, fans must enter the promo code FREAKY-XY1H3A at checkout.

Sources:

- [Bamberg Baskets: FREAKY FRIDAY mit Ticket- und Trikot-Angeboten! | Bamberg Baskets](https://www.bamberg.basketball/news/freaky-friday-mit-ticket-und-trikot-angeboten)

## Around the League

### Bamberg Baskets Celebrate Freak City Day at Store

The Bamberg Baskets are hosting a special event at their Freak City Store, celebrating Freak City Day as part of their Freak Week. Fans can meet a player live at the store, participate in activities such as a ball toss game, and enter a giveaway. Customers who spend at least €30 will receive a discount, with increasing percentages for higher spending amounts. The store is also offering additional deals on its Instagram account, where fans can follow along and receive notifications about daily promotions. The event is taking place today, with the store open for customers to take advantage of the offers.

Sources:

- [Bamberg Baskets: HEUTE IST FREAK CITY DAY IM STORE! | Bamberg Baskets](https://www.bamberg.basketball/news/heute-ist-freak-city-day-im-store)

### Bamberg Baskets host Jena in Toyota 2. Damen Basketball Bundesliga

The Medikamente per Klick Bamberg Baskets, who remain undefeated at home this season, will face the VITAMINAQUA Baskets from Jena in the 8th round of the Toyota 2. Damen Basketball Bundesliga. The Bambergerinnen have won five of their seven games so far, while the Thüringerinnen have only won one game. The Bamberg Baskets' Head Coach is Samuel Gloser, while the Jena team is led by Cheftrainerin Sandra Rosanke. The two teams met earlier in the season, with the Jena team winning 82-76 on the 5th round. The game will take place on Sunday at 16:00 in the Graf-Stauffenberg-Halle, with tickets available online, in the Freak City Store, or at the door. The Bamberg Baskets will be wearing orange jerseys in support of the UN Women Deutschland e.V. 'ORANGE THE WORLD!' campaign against violence against women.

Sources:
